market: Global AI in Geospatial Imaging & Remote Sensing Market
market_definition: Global AI in Geospatial Imaging & Remote Sensing Market. Product / technology: AI software: computer vision, deep learning, GeoAI platforms, foundation models; data source: drone imagery, satellite imagery, LiDAR, thermal, hyperspectral, IoT; hardware: edge AI modules, GPU/cloud infrastructure. Business models: AI model development, data annotation, image analytics, defect detection, change detection, managed analytics, platform subscription. Applications: Infrastructure inspection, crop health, forestry, land-use classification, utilities, disaster response, smart cities, environmental monitoring, defense. End users: Government, telecom, energy and utilities, construction, agriculture, mining, insurance, transportation, environmental agencies. Geography: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Middle East & Africa; India and Southeast Asia as high-growth focus markets.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR / CHANNEL PARTNER DEFINITION (hardware + software market): this market sells both hardware and software, so two shapes qualify - a stocking or authorized DISTRIBUTOR buying hardware in volume and reselling it, and a CHANNEL PARTNER, value-added reseller or SYSTEM INTEGRATOR that resells, bundles or implements another vendor's platform, software or modules. EXCLUDED: manufacturers, OEMs and their sales subsidiaries; vendors selling their own platform; consultancies with nothing to resell; and consumer-only retailers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
